params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Briar's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} inflict a bleed against enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 5 times and dealing {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage for stacks beyond the first. The bleed deals{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 50}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|(10 to 50)*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration, increased by {{as|{{pplevel|10*0.25 to 50*0.25}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|(10*0.25 to 50*0.25)*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*{{#var:i_maxd}} to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{pplevel|(10*{{#var:i_maxd}} to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}})*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration.|{{as|{{pplevel|10/(5/0.5) to 50/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|(10/(5/0.5) to 50/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(50/(5/0.5)*0.25)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased by {{as|{{pplevel|10*0.25/(5/0.5) to 50*0.25/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|(10*0.25/(5/0.5) to 50*0.25/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(50*0.25/(5/0.5))*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5) to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{pplevel|(10*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5) to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}}  {{as|(+ {{ap|(50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5))*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} per tick.}}If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% <!--pre or post mitigation?--> of the remaining bleed damage.
params.description2: '''Briar''' has no {{sti|health regeneration|{{as|'''base''' health regeneration}}}}, but she increases healing from all sources by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 40 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.4% per 1% missing health}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 2.5 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.025% per 1% missing health}}|health}} per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}.
params.notes:

For each stack, the target is dealt {{as|physical damage}} and '''Briar''' {{tip|heal|heals}} for a portion of it.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.85}} seconds, and reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 5 seconds.

params.notes:
* ''Head Rush'' can be cast on [[jungle plants]], {{tip|wards}}, and {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}.
** It cannot be cast on {{tip|structures}}.
* ''Head Rush'' does not force the target's armor and magic resistance to update immediately outside of the {{tt|natural stat update cycle|once every 0.25 seconds}}, meaning its damage will typically still be mitigated by the unreduced armor value.
* ''Head Rush's'' damage benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
* ''Head Rush'' is a non-following dash.
** It picks its dash destination ~100 units in front of enemy targets, 75 units in front of enemy targets when already very close to them, 75 units in front of allied targets. 
** If already within 75 units of her target, she dashes to her current location, which takes 0 time but still triggers dash effects such as {{ri|Sudden Impact}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Briar}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them briefly, and additionally reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for a few seconds.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. If there is a nearby enemy upon her arrival, she gains ''Blood Frenzy'' for 5 seconds, during which she can cast ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}''.
params.description2: {{sbc|Blood Frenzy:}} '''Briar''' breaks free from her pillory, causing her to become {{tt|forced|See notes}} to basic attack the nearest enemy. She {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} the target and gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, as well as empowering her basic attacks to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies surrounding her target. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.description3: '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking {{tip|champions}}, then large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|minions}}, and then any other unit. If she casts ''{{ai|Head Rush|Briar}}'' on a minion or monster, she will shift her target priority to large monsters, minions or champions, then any other unit.
params.description4: ''Blood Frenzy causes '''Briar''' to become unable to receive movement and attack commands. The frenzy ends early if there are no longer any nearby valid targets or {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} is cast. Blood Frenzy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Head Rush|Briar}} and {{ai|Certain Death|Briar}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.target range: {{dv|{{tt|75 - 300|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}|{{tt|650|Maximum extended dash distance across terrain}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1000|Frenzy target radius}}|{{tt|275|Attack cleave radius around primary target}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Blood Frenzy'' acquires targets regardless of if they are visible or not.
** This does not apply to {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} targets.
** It cannot acquire {{tip|ward|wards}}, [[jungle plants]], or structures however.
* The target priority shift from casting {{ai|Q|Briar}} on a minion or monster will occur even if the dash is interrupted.
* If the main attack {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, the cleave damage will do so as well.
* '''Briar''' uses {{tip|Frenzy}} as a [[Ability resource#Frenzy|resource]] to indicate the remaining duration of the frenzy, in seconds.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Briar''' is in her frenzy:
** While in the frenzy, '''Briar''' cannot control her movement nor declare who she attacks. She will automatically acquire a nearby enemy as her attack target based on a priority system, becoming ''forced'' to basic attack the target and consequently move into her attack range of them to do so.
*** {{tip|Disarming crowd control}} as well as any other lockout that would disable basic attacking will disable the forced attacks.
*** {{tip|Forced action}} crowd control will cause her forced attacks to be either overridden or disabled, depending on the actions being forced by the debuff.

The mark's application {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} the target's ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}. While the target is marked, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.description2: If a target is hit, '''Briar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} herself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and becomes {{tip|cc-immune|immune to them}} over a cast time, afterwards {{tip|dash|dashing}} to them with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|flee|fears}} all non-marked targets for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%. She then enters a state of ''Hematomania''.

''Hematomania'' lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including '''Briar's''' or the target's death.

params.notes:
* {{Pending for test}} The dash is considered an ability activation for the purposes of {{ii|Sheen}} and {{cai|Force Pulse|Kassadin}}.
* '''Briar''' will track the target with the {{tip|dash}} if they change locations.
** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
* '''Briar''' lands 100 units in front of her target at the end of the dash.
* '''Briar''' will not initiate the second cast if she is being {{tip|suppression|suppressed}}, is under {{tip|resurrection}}, or is in the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}} when her target is hit by the missile in the normal realm.
** Since ''Certain Death'' cleanses herself from all crowd control when the first cast hits, she will be able to start the second cast due to removing the suppression effect.
* '''Briar''' will still dash to the target even if they die before she reaches them.
* '''Briar''' will transition from having {{tip|cc-immune|total crowd control immunity}} during the cast time of the dash, to having {{tip|displacement immunity}} during the dash.
* '''Briar''' will place herself onto the ground and interrupt {{tip|airborne|displacements}} affecting her upon starting the second cast time.
* ''Hematomania's'' targeting priorities differ slightly from that of ''{{ais|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'':
** She will prioritize the marked target regardless of range and over all other units as long as it can be attacked.
*** If the marked target is not available, then she shifts her priority to the nearest other champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit in a global radius.
* Starting the second cast interrupts any spells that '''Briar''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}.
* The mark will expire if ''Hematomania's'' buff is dispelled.
* Casting ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' during ''Hematomania'' will not grant any additional bonuses nor will it override ''Hematomania's'' effects.
** Gaining ''Hematomania'' while ''Blood Frenzy'' is active will override the previous buff.
** Casting  ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' during ''Hematomania'' does allow the use of ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}''. However, both ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'''s effects and the ability to use ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}'' are immediately interrupted upon exiting ''Hematomania''.
* The {{tip|disrupt}} is 'wrapped' into a status effect that causes the affected champion to display the "{{tip|silence|Silenced}}" UI on their [[Health bar#Disabled state|health bar]] for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, without actually applying the disabling effects of the {{tip|silence}} crowd control type (functions as an indicator of the target becoming ''disrupted''). This however ensures that the ''disrupt'' is also prevented by effects that would negate {{tip|silence|silences}} (such as {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}).
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate at the end of ''Certain Death's'' initial cast time. If the missile hits a target, the buff's duration is refreshed at the end of the dash.
